decisions.reason: The Small Block ticket window and reset rules remain unchanged; current-holder eligibility is owned by the winner-selection Requirement.
The Big Block ticket window and reset rules remain unchanged; current-holder eligibility is owned by the winner-selection Requirement.
The existing message-146 FAQ MODIFY already records that more held tickets provide more opportunities and that active tickets transfer to a resale buyer.
Changing draw eligibility to current active-ticket holders does not alter when referral tickets are issued, their quantities, or their per-draw cycles.
The no-referral allocation to a randomly selected existing NFT holder remains valid and is independent of subsequent draw-winner eligibility.
The change to winner eligibility and ticket weighting does not alter the Winners-page one-click prize claim flow.
The referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, and automatic wallet payout are unaffected by prize-winner eligibility.
The separate Small and Big Block counters and their draw-specific resets remain valid; the source does not change their accounting definitions.
Ticket weighting and current-holder eligibility do not change which ticket counters, badges, or referral-code attribute are exposed in NFT metadata.
The flat secondary-sale royalty remains unchanged and is not affected by who holds eligible prize tickets.
The existing message-146 MODIFY already records that active prize tickets transfer to the new buyer, fully representing the resale consequence of current-holder eligibility.
Changing the eligible winner population and ticket weighting does not alter announcement of winners on the Winners page.
